combo_label: The Garage × At the Funfair × James Bond

entries.clue: The very first Bond film was shot on this Caribbean island in 1962
Noah's floating refuge; an undulating fairground ride took the same name
Rising tide of bags and boxes along one side until nothing else fits
Silent henchman whose steel-brimmed hat beheads a stone statue
His Scottish family estate, and the 2012 film named after it
Place where something is built or held; the fair rents one for the week
Ian who invented him, drawing on his own naval intelligence work
Stiff canvas square spread across the floor to catch every splash
Hand whose lines are read for a future in the little curtained tent
Screw-driven clamp fixed to a worktop, gripping the job while you file
Sound out with a brassy roar, as the steam organ does all day
Lowest part of the crankcase, where the black stuff collects between changes
